# dify_tool_provider_credential (Resource)

Manages a builtin tool provider credential in Dify. `provider_name` is the provider path such as `langgenius/tavily/tavily`. Credential values are write-only: the API never returns them, so state keeps the configured values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Install the tool plugin first.
resource "dify_plugin_install" "tavily" {
  plugin_unique_identifier = "langgenius/tavily:0.1.7@5fce9cf01fecda9ad92e5125397d2bb5497429baed276c7f14f033e7debd0abe"
}

# Then configure credentials for the tool provider.
resource "dify_tool_provider_credential" "tavily" {
  provider_name = "langgenius/tavily/tavily"
  name          = "production-key"

  credentials = {
    tavily_api_key = var.tavily_api_key
  }

  depends_on = [dify_plugin_install.tavily]
}

variable "tavily_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials` (Map of String, Sensitive) Credential key-value pairs keyed by the provider's credential form fields (e.g. `tavily_api_key`). Write-only and sensitive.
- `provider_name` (String) Tool provider id (e.g. `langgenius/tavily/tavily`).

### Optional

- `name` (String) Human-readable name for this credential (max 30 characters).

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether this is the provider's default credential.
- `credential_id` (String) Credential ID (assigned by Dify after creation).
